en: <CLT=cltMIND>There's a lot of washing machines here...

<CLT=cltMIND>These are some powerful cleaning tools. You
could get a lot of cleaning done with these.

<CLT=cltMIND>It's just a monitor. Even if I investigate,
I don't think I'll find anything suspicious...

<CLT=cltMIND>Maybe there's a camera in here,
watching us... Maybe not.

<CLT=cltMIND>This closet has vacuum cleaners
and a high-powered pressure washer.

<CLT=cltMIND>You could get a lot of
cleaning done with these...

<CLT=cltMIND>There's a doll at the dining table...
Perhaps a family dinner?
